subject: Request: LaunchLabs accelerator credit exception & billing path
content:
From: Emily Park <emily@launchlabs.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@accelerateco.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: LaunchLabs accelerator credits — ask and timeline

Hi Soojin, Ben —

Thanks again for the onboarding walkthrough last week. LaunchLabs is excited to get a prototype running against a few cohorts next month. We have two asks before procurement will sign off:

- Can Redwood make a one-time exception to let us convert up to $30k of promotional onboarding credits into a transitional committed discount that applies to the first three months on Dedicated (to help stabilize predictable run rates)?
- If so, can you confirm the billing path — will the discount be applied as an invoice credit or reduced unit rates? Procurement needs the billing model for our PO.

I attached our onboarding worksheet with estimated usage and the promo credit balance for transparency. If you need a short proposal/term sheet, we can fast-track approvals on our side.

Ideal timeline: decision this week so procurement can route a PO by Friday (24th).

Thanks —
Emily Park
Head of Accelerator Programs
LaunchLabs

Attachment: LaunchLabs_ONB_worksheet.xlsx (spreadsheet with cohort usage estimates)

---

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily@launchlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LaunchLabs accelerator credits — ask and timeline

Hi Emily —

Appreciate the clear ask and the worksheet — that helps. Short answer: we can accommodate a conversion but it will need a narrow, documented exception (one-off) and a short addendum to the SOW so finance has an audit trail. Proposed approach: 

1) Convert up to $30,000 of existing promo credits to a time-bound committed discount applied as a line-item credit on the first three monthly invoices (i.e., invoice credits totaling $30k split across months). This keeps bookkeeping straightforward.
2) Use a brief term sheet (one page) that captures: converted amount, three-month amortization schedule, conditions (no retroactive conversion beyond the $30k), and confirmation of the Dedicated config.
3) Procurement/PO path: finance needs to see the term sheet + the PO referencing Deal ID LL-2025-0821.

I drafted a quick term sheet and attached it (credit-conversion-term-sheet.pdf). Ben — can you validate the numbers and confirm we can do this without a pricing committee review? Lauren — can you approve a one-time exception for this account (they're within our PLG-to-Enterprise conversion motion and likely to ramp to a >$100k ARR committed next 12 months)?

If we have verbal yes today, Emily — we’ll send the one-page addendum for countersignature and confirm the invoice credit mechanics so procurement can issue the PO.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: credit-conversion-term-sheet.pdf

---

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 13:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: LaunchLabs accelerator credits — ask and timeline

+1 on approving — numbers look clean in the term sheet. A few operational notes:

- Finance confirmed we can issue invoice credits across three billing cycles as long as the addendum is signed before the first billing date.
- We should tie the converted credit to a usage cap for the promo portion (to avoid unintended over-consumption counts against the committed discount). The worksheet Emily sent has reasonable estimates; I'd propose we cap the credit application to the cohort usage lines only and exclude non-cohort spikes.
- Given timeline, I'd authorize a one-time executive exception of up to $30k without routing to pricing committee, provided Lauren signs off.

Lauren — can you approve the exception and the proposed PO verbiage below? If yes, I'll prepare internal finance routing and Soojin can send the addendum to Emily.

Proposed PO verbiage (short): 
"This PO references Deal ID LL-2025-0821 and the Redwood one-time credit conversion addendum dated July 2025. The credit will be applied as invoice credits across three consecutive monthly invoices per the addendum."

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

---

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jul 2025 16:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LaunchLabs accelerator credits — ask and timeline

Approved — one-time exception up to $30k. Please ensure: 
- The addendum limits the conversion to onboarding-promo credits only.
- There is a clause requiring LaunchLabs to sign the addendum before the first invoice date.
- Finance retains right to audit applied credits against the cohorts listed in the attached worksheet.

Ben — proceed with routing. Soojin — send the addendum and request countersignature.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: Emily Park <emily@launchlabs.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, procurement@launchlabs.com
Date: Thu, 24 Jul 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: LaunchLabs accelerator credits — ask and timeline

Fantastic — thank you all for the quick turnaround and alignment. Procurement has routed a draft PO (attached) that references the deal id you provided. Two quick asks from our side: 

1) Can Redwood confirm the exact invoice dates the credit will hit (so our accounting can match)?
2) We need the one-page addendum to include the cohort usage cap language (as Lauren requested).

I've attached the PO draft (LL_PO_Draft_2025-07-24.docx). Procurement will sign as soon as we receive the addendum and confirmation of invoice dates. If it's helpful, Samir from our finance integration partner is on the thread and can expedite the PO once the term sheet is final.

Thanks —
Emily Park
Head of Accelerator Programs
LaunchLabs

Attachment: LL_PO_Draft_2025-07-24.docx
